title: Coordinates and change of ordered basis
objectives: Compute coordinate matrices relative to an ordered basis
Build the change-of-basis matrix and apply it in the correct direction
Prove that the change-of-basis matrix is invertible and unique
Construct the ordered basis determined by an invertible matrix
prerequisites: Chapters 2 and 4: invertibility by row reduction, bases and dimension.
source_scope: The caption of Lecture 8 was read in full; the polynomial running example, the second numerical example, the counting and the exercises are original.
